description: Execute the complete registered smoke suite, or one registered smoke through the canonical runner with its private import environment and measured entry budgets. A single smoke must be registered, in quality_gates/gate_smokes.txt or in any fragment under quality_gates/gate_smokes.d/, which count equally. This working-tree diagnostic is explicitly uncached; frozen candidate selection and clean-only reuse use run_selected_smokes with a platform-smoke-proof/v1 request. The complete suite remains a separate physical battery and returns bounded output with truncation disclosed.
embedding_description: Run the complete gate_smokes.txt suite or one registered smoke through the canonical runner and private import environment. Working-tree diagnostics are uncached. Frozen selection and clean-only reuse use run_selected_smokes; full-suite timing and skips remain explicit evidence.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Target, passed, exit_code, summary, bounded output and truncation fields; single-smoke runs also retain canonical import-environment and original attempt evidence. Uncached working-tree diagnostics are not frozen proofs.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with target and passed. On failure, surface 'summary' (the N/M line) and the failing-smoke tail from 'output'; note truncation against output_chars_total when 'truncated' is true.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Running the complete registered suite, or one registered smoke through the shared canonical runner and private import environment. Complete-suite timing uses a measured or explicitly conservative budget.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValueError/QualityGateError: the requested smoke path is in neither quality_gates/gate_smokes.txt nor any fragment under quality_gates/gate_smokes.d/ — only registered smokes may be run (this is the allowlist boundary), and registering one means adding its path as a line in your own fragment file, NOT a test failure. A suite/smoke that runs but fails returns passed=false with exit_code!=0. timed_out=true with exit_code 124 means the wall-clock cap fired before the suite finished.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For an unregistered-smoke error: call list_gates to see the registered smoke paths (it returns the union of the register and its fragments), register the smoke by adding one line to your own file under quality_gates/gate_smokes.d/, or omit the argument to run the whole suite. For a real failure (passed=false): read 'summary' and the failing-smoke output and fix the code under test. For a timeout: run a single smoke instead of the full suite to narrow the slow test.
